record.title: Microduck right sole — mirror of microduck-sole-left about x=0 (measured true mirror, p95 0.002 mm): same shell and socket
record.origin_why: v0.0.2 is a parametric rebuild: sole_right.stl is sole_left.stl mirrored about x=0 (point-to-triangle p95 0.002 mm, max 0.008 mm — out/measure/foot/measure2.py); every number in cad/part.py was measured off Pollen Robotics’ decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice intervals/segments and cecad.meshfeatures (probe scripts in out/measure/foot/); nobody has Pollen’s CAD and no physical part has been measured. v0.0.1 (kept) was the vendor mesh loaded as-is.
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-sole-right) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen’s own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/sole_right.stl: p95 0.05/0.06 mm, median 0.005/0.005, bbox delta [-0.03, 0.0, -0.003] mm, 0 features to match. The report is the ledger artifact (evidence/refcheck/).
record.why_this_folder_exists: The right ground-contact of the Microduck (MJCF places sole_right once, on body ankle_right). One hand flip away from microduck-sole-left.
